scripts.build: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run types:check && pnpm run build:control && pnpm run build:gateway
scripts.check:startup: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run check:startup:control && pnpm run check:startup:gateway
scripts.check:startup:control: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.control.jsonc --compatibility-date 2026-08-22 --outfile dist/control-startup.bundle && wrangler check startup --worker dist/control-startup.bundle --outfile dist/control-startup.cpuprofile
scripts.check:startup:gateway: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc --compatibility-date 2026-08-22 --outfile dist/gateway-startup.bundle && wrangler check startup --worker dist/gateway-startup.bundle --outfile dist/gateway-startup.cpuprofile
scripts.dev:control: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler dev --config wrangler.control.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.dev:gateway: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler dev --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc --port 8788
scripts.migrations:apply:local: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.control.jsonc --local
scripts.migrations:apply:remote: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.control.jsonc --remote
scripts.test: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run migrations:test && vitest run
scripts.types:check: wrangler types src/generated/control-env.d.ts --config wrangler.control.jsonc --env-interface CloudflareControlEnv --check && wrangler types src/generated/gateway-env.d.ts --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc --config wrangler.control.jsonc --env-interface CloudflareGatewayEnv --include-runtime false --check
scripts.types:generate: pnpm run types:generate:control && pnpm run types:generate:gateway
scripts.types:generate:gateway: wrangler types src/generated/gateway-env.d.ts --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc --config wrangler.control.jsonc --env-interface CloudflareGatewayEnv --include-runtime false
